comment: Data-driven chat-template override catalog. A model whose GGUF-embedded chat template llama.cpp's minja engine cannot parse (any template carrying a Jinja raise_exception guard such as 'System message must be at the beginning') is fixed by adding an entry here - no Go code change. Match fields: arch (GGUF general.architecture, case-insensitive) or basename (filepath.Base of the model file, case-insensitive substring). The first enabled entry whose arch or basename matches wins. 'template_file' names a .jinja file in this package's templates/ directory, embedded into the binary. 'enabled: false' disables an entry without deleting it.
